description_en: Grants a user the permissions to access a database instance by using the secure access proxy feature
description_zh: 授予用户安全访问代理权限
name: CreateProxyAccess

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user. You can call the ListUsers (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/data-management-service/latest/listusers) or GetUser (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/data-management-service/latest/getuser) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 用户ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141938.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147098.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the security protection agent. You can call the ListProxies (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/data-management-service/latest/listproxies) or GetProxy (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/data-management-service/latest/getproxy) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 安全访问代理ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/295371.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/295382.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: proxy_id

parameters.help_en: The password that is used to log on to the database
parameters.name: indep_password

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the GetUserActiveTenant (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/data-management-service/latest/getuseractivetenant) or ListUserTenants (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/data-management-service/latest/listusertenants) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: tid

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned to the query task

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message that is returned

ProxyAccessId.description_en: The ID of the security protection authorization. After the security protection agent authorizes the target user, the system automatically generates a security protection authorization ID. The ID is globally unique
ProxyAccessId.description_zh: 安全访问授权ID，当安全访问代理授权目标用户后，系统会自动生成一个安全访问授权ID，该ID全局唯一

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful
